results.message: You're in T4 with about 2 hours to boarding, which is plenty of time for souvenir shopping. Here's a walking route: 1) Heritage Zone (about 15 min) is a free Peranakan exhibit with interactive displays, a nice way to see some local culture first. 2) Lego Airport Store (about 10 min) sells Changi-themed sets you can't get elsewhere, and the display build is worth a look even if you don't buy. Then, for the gifts themselves, Taste Singapore is my top pick for edible souvenirs like laksa paste, chilli crab sauce and kaya jam, and Zakkasg is good for affordable stationery and small trinkets. TWG Tea Salon (about 20 min) would be a good tea stop too, but it's peak dinner time so expect a wait. Leave about 15 minutes at the end for the walk to your gate.
